dct_title_s: Map of property owned by J.M. Goetchius, situated in the Boroughs of Undercliff and Cliffside, Bergen Co., N.J., Dec. 1896
dct_description_sm: Map showing the property lines along the Hudson River belonging to J.M. Goetchius
